programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jennas första dejt till återföreningsfesten lockar fram skuldkänslor för de tjejer som inte har någon dejt. Hon minns när hon var en av dem.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter en kopp kaffe med Collin en sen kväll kan Jenna inte sluta tänka på honom och vad det betyder att vara förtjust i någon annan än sin pojkvän.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Spänningar uppstår mellan Jenna och Matty när Collin bjuder in henne till en flott fotoutställning hemma hos sig.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter att ha impulsstrulat med Collin beslutar sig Jenna för att sluta med sitt vänsterprassel innan Matty får reda på det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Vad hände egentligen på överraskningsfesten - och är det verkligen helt slut mellan Jenna och Matty? Det vet bara de två, men deras vänner minns den ödesdigra stunden och försöker att fylla i luckorna.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna ställer till med grillfest för att hennes vänner ska vänja sig vid tanken på hennes och Collins spirande förhållande. Men när deras stöd uteblir av en eller annan orsak tar hon till drastiska åtgärder.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter att ha gjort sig ovän med Tamara och Ming tycker Jenna att det inte spelar nån roll vad hon gör längre - och hon hamnar i ett jobbigt läge.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val ber Mr Harts klass att skriva och framföra en egen skolpjäs, och sensmoralen i den är mer än välbekant.

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterverkningarna av Jennas gräl med vännerna gör att hon går ut en kväll. Men vad som skulle bli en kväll för att lätta på trycket blir en kväll hon behöver räddning från.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det är dags för Jenna att återgå till den rätta vägen, men hon har ställt till med mer skada för sina närmaste än vad som kan rättas till med lite PR. Kommer de att förlåta henne eller måste hon ta till drastiska åtgärder?

programme.title: Another Period: Lillian's Wedding
programme.desc: Lillian tänker gifta sig med en gammal och rik man: Laverne. Det slår gnistor mellan Hortense och Lavernes stilige sonson Bertram. Fredericks chans att bli vicepresident hotas av smygtagna foton, och han förvisar Beatrice från Bellacourt.

programme.title: Another Period: The Duel

programme.desc: Neil deGrasse Tyson slappnar av hemma, Keegan måste skärpa sig på en jobbintervju, en skräddare har en kund med gaser, dörrvakterna diskuterar 'Game of Thrones' och en telefonförsäljare testar en ny strategi.

programme.title: Key & Peele: A Cappella Club

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass: In Recovery

programme.desc: I det första avsnittet möter vi Tine och Lars, som har svindlande åtta miljoner för att köpa ett hus och renovera. Men budgeten har inte hjälpt dem hittills - kan experterna vara till hjälp?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 402
programme.desc: Experterna åker till Hørning, där en präst och hennes familj behöver ett nytt hem. Idag hyr de ett litet radhus och nu vill de flytta.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: See Ya, Nat!
programme.desc: Nat har inte mått bra och bestämmer sig för att ta bort tatueringen med exets namn för att må bättre. Men efter att ha funderat bestämmer hon sig för att åka för gott. Beau och Bethan har ett spänt samtal om framtiden.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Chloe Changes Her Ways!
programme.desc: Bethan bestämmer sig för att åka hem för att jobba med sig själv men Beau stannar kvar. På en fest i huset gör Ant att Louis och Chloe blir osams, vilket orsakar osämja bland killarna. Chloe visar äntligen att hon är en stark, oberoende kvinna!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordie-licious!
programme.desc: Det är sista kvällen och gänget ska vara värdar för ett evenemang som heter Geordie-licious! De känner pressen att fixa en fest som alla kommer att minnas. Amelia sjunger och killarna strippar. Louis och Chloe verkar vilja samma sak.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Singles Have Landed
programme.desc: Efter en allt för lång karantän är Geordiegänget tillbaka! Men den här gången delar de huset med ett gäng sexiga singlar de ska dejta.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Someone's Getting Dumped

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Chloe Shoots Her Shot
programme.desc: Abbie hamnar mitt i ett storbråk, Nathan blir rånad, och Chloe lägger in en stöt på Louis.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Ciao, Italia

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 405
programme.desc: Mike, Ronnie, Sammi, Vinny och Deena diskuterar de första dramatiska och roliga avsnitten av den fjärde säsongen. Vi får veta allt om Deenas vilda strul och om grälet som gick rakt in i väggen.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 407
programme.desc: Känslorna svallar när Snooki, Jenni, Deena och Mike samlas för att prata om Mikes påstådda strul med Snooki - för att inte tala om vad som hände när köttbullarna hamnade i säng tillsammans.

programme.desc: Efter en sommar fylld av tömda och krossade flaskor, hjärtesorg, lesbioniska strul, bilolyckor och väggdramatik, samlas gänget för att strö salt i varandras sår och ta farväl av Florens.

programme.desc: Gruppen återvänder från Italien och är överlyckliga över att vara tillbaka på Jersey Shore. Men det drar ihop sig till dramastorm när Mike hotar att förstöra Snookis förhållande med Jionni.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tourist Trap
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey

programme.title: Past Hunters: Thackray Medical Museum
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters investigate Thackray Medical Museum, believed to one of Leeds most haunted buildings. Workers claim to have witnessed constant paranormal activity in the museum and one claim is that two Victorian ghosts are trapped...

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Static

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Prime Mover

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Miss May Dusa

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: My Ghostwriter - The Vampire

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: My Own Place

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Red Leader

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Everybody Needs A Little Love

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Auld Acquaintances

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Social Climber

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Swap
programme.desc: Anna Belle's plot to murder her husband to gain his money backfires with unpleasant results.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Let The Games Begin

programme.title: JAG: Pilot Error

programme.title: JAG: Sightings

programme.title: JAG: Defensive Action

programme.title: CBS Morning News

programme.title: CBS Mornings

programme.title: Banksy and the Rise of Outlaw Art

programme.title: Combat Forces: Paratroopers
programme.desc: Airborne soldiers are known as force multipliers because of their unique capabilities. Dropped behind enemy lines they can secure bridges or conduct ambushes.

programme.title: Myths & Monsters: The Wild Unknown
programme.desc: Forest and mountain, sea and ice – the wilds of this world are a rich setting for myths and legends. As this episode shows, the stories told about the wilderness can tell us a lot about a people.

programme.title: Combat Forces: Simulated Warfare
programme.desc: High technology is changing the modern battlefield. It is also changing training. In this episode, we examine the different types of simulators and other related technology that is being used to help make soldiers more battle-ready.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Conqueror
programme.desc: Humankind conquered the world, in order to survive, and conquers his fellow humans with new ideas. We will see how we as a species have conquered the earth, how we still compete with viruses, and how quantum theory conquers China.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 211
programme.desc: A truck flips on flooded roads, trapping a family in their upside down car. A thrill seeking photographer gets too close to a hurricane. A chaser flips his car in a wild tornado chase. A mudslide sends a truck over a steep incline.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization II: The Arabs
programme.desc: The pioneering Arabs revolutionizing mathematics and medicine.

programme.title: On the Case: Golden Promises Broken
programme.desc: High school sweethearts disappear during a picnic and investigators spend years chasing false leads.

programme.title: On the Case: Snake in the Grass
programme.desc: A cloud of smoke leads two truckers to a shocking discovery; the smoldering remains of a teenage girl.

programme.title: On the Case: Evidence of Deception
programme.desc: When a beautiful college coed is found dead in her dorm room police discover a crime scene where nothing is what it appears to be.

programme.title: On the Case: Lost In The Fire
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother of two is found shot to death in her fire-ravaged home, police find there are more suspects than clues.

programme.title: On the Case: Innocent Witness
programme.desc: When Rhonda Boggs is discovered murdered in her own kitchen, police get an important lead from the only witness to the crime, Rhonda's two year old daughter.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Yukon
programme.desc: When thunderstorms and a shaking engine threaten a DC-3 charter to Whitehorse, Joe pulls out all the stops to get the passengers to their destination.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: British Invasion
programme.desc: oe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Arnie Calls It
programme.desc: While training waterbomber captains for the upcoming fire-fighting season, Chief Pilot Arnie makes a surprising decision. AJ becomes a DC-4 captain and ponders whether to accept a promotion.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under New Management
programme.desc: Joe hires outsider Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey. Gord and Sean's DC-3 delivery mission to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dambusters
programme.desc: Buffalo gets into the stunt flying business when veteran pilot Arnie flies the DC-4 for the re- enactment scene of a famous WWII bombing raid.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Chuck Walks
programme.desc: Critical of the many stops and starts in the Electra program, and frustrated with the constant drama at Buffalo, Chuck quits. Joe clashes with the maintenance department when a series of delays puts the sale of an old Canso waterbomber in jeopardy.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: San Diego 2
programme.desc: IGFA Anglers Digest takes you all on a fishing nirvana vacation aboard Captain Frank LoPreste’s famous long range sportfisher, the Royal Polaris.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Puerto Rico
programme.desc: The 60th anniversary of the famous Club Nautico Yacht Club provides the venue for this exciting marlin fishing extravaganza where the docks are filled with the WHO’S WHO of the Caribbean sport fishing industry and several IGFA dignitaries as well.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Best Of
programme.desc: This is a remarkable WRAP-UP of the best highlights of the first season of IGFA Anglers Digest on WFN.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Lindberghs Reindeer Lake Pike
programme.desc: Destination is Lindbergh' Reindeer Lake Lodge in northern Saskatchewan. If you have ever dreamed of catching Pike until your arms hurt, and some of them true monsters, this is your destination. Learn a few tricks and hang on!

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Florida Bass and Flatfish Salmon
programme.desc: This episode starts in Kissimmee Florida, then out in Lake Ontario for early Salmon. Fishing during cold fronts can be challenging, but a few tricks will keep the rods bent and the fish hitting.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: P.E.I. Bluefin Tuna
programme.desc: Destination is North Lake PEI fishing for Giant Bluefin Tuna on the Lil' Miss Maddy with Capt.Tony MacDonald. The team is up to the challenge... get ready for a true monster hunt!

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Slow Death Walleye and Lunkerhunt Goby
programme.desc: An informative episode... first Walleye fishing in the north country. Attention to detail always pay off. Then drop shot rigs for Bass on Lake Erie.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: New Brunswick Sturgeon
programme.desc: Fishing the St.John area in N.B. for Sturgeon. There are plenty of fish to enjoy but a few tricks, attention to detail and proper boat position can make it even more enjoyable.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Big Fish of the Year
programme.desc: A highlight of some of the largest fish caught this year. This is for the viewers who love to see the monsters!!

programme.title: IFISH: Mako on Fly - St Helens, TAS
programme.desc: Paul and the crew head to St Helens, Tasmania to chase Mako Sharks on fly. A school of tuna under the boat, a Mako Shark appears and you won't believe what happens next!

programme.title: Games People Play: Persons of Interests
programme.desc: Loomis ser Cooper vid en Vipersmatch. Cooper tvingas lämna ifrån sig övervakningsfilmen från bråket mellan Vanessa och Kalinda. Hon erbjuder sig att lämna in den för att behålla jobbet, men får sparken när hon gör det.

programme.title: Games People Play: A Wing and A Prayer
programme.desc: Laila hamnar i en farlig situation. MJ hör rykten om att nån läcker uppgifter om familjen King. Vanessas familj hotas och hon bestämmer att det är dags att agera.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Bitch is Back
programme.desc: Laila gömmer sig, oförmögen att tillbringa natten ensam. Vanessa köper motvilligt en ny telefon till Laila, som snart får veta att Susie Q är död. Vanessa tvingas trösta henne, trots att hon knappt tål henne.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Way You Save
programme.desc: Kareem säger till Marcus att han inte kan leva i hans skugga och ber honom att få bli utköpt. Marcus betalar honom 250 000. Kareem och Quanisha åker till Jamal med en väska med pengar för att få honom att försvinna.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Freedom
programme.desc: Mary Jane ser fram emot en ångestfri helg men planerna går i stöpet när Mark ringer och ber henne om hjälp med hans föräldrar som är på besök. Avslöjanden under besöket tvingar Mark att göra en förändring.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mary Jane Knows Best
programme.desc: Efter att Mary Janes affär har avslöjats tvingas hon inse att hon är mer intresserad än hon trott. Patricks fest för att fira nykterhet ger en bild av hur han en gång var.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Sleepless In Atlanta
programme.desc: Kara försöker skydda Mary Jane från resultatet från en fokusgrupp, Niecy försöker skydda sig själv och Treyvion från hans far, som plötsligt återvänder från college. Patrick försöker balansera arbete och familj och Mary Jane träffar Sheldon.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 3
programme.desc: Killarna försöker hitta världens bästa superbil med fyra säten, medan Harry Potter-stjärnan Rupert Grint är stjärnan i den rimligt prissatta bilen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 4
programme.desc: Killarna på Top Gear bygger coola och intressanta husbilar innan de ger sig av på ett långt veckoslut till West Country.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 7
programme.desc: Killarna åker på en lång bilresa längs den amerikanska östkusten i en Mercedes SLS, en Porsche 911 GT3 RS och en Ferrari 458 Italia.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 1
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond och James May ger sig ut på en säsongsbetonad roadtrip när de försöker följa de tre vise männens väg över Mellanöstern.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 2
programme.desc: Återinförandet av Cool Wall utlöser en livlig debatt i studion. Ståuppkomikern John Bishop är stjärnan i en Rimligt prissatt bil.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Skurken, äcklet, hans älskare och hennes syster
programme.desc: Jake återvänder till Los Angeles, där FBI belönar honom med 50 000 dollar för sin insats i Palmer Woodward-fallet och använder pengarna för att köpa Shooters.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Kärleken suger
programme.desc: Chris friar till Jane och uppmanar henne att köra till Las Vegas för en hastig vigsel, vilket får Sydney att varna Michael och Kimberly.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Dr Jekyll räddar skinnet
programme.desc: När Michael får sparken för att han lämnat jobbet för att stoppa vigseln mellan Jane och Chris, ber han Amanda att lägga in ett gott ord åt honom.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Rättvisa åt ingen
programme.desc: Alison goes over the deep end when she realizes that Billy and Susan now live together. Jo's custody battle for her unborn baby begins.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Dagar med vin och vodka
programme.desc: Alison fortsätter att umgås med Zach samtidigt som hon förnekar sitt problem med alkoholen, till Billy och Susans stora missnöje.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 904
programme.desc: Martin får sin andra bedömning av läkarförbundet och Buddy försvinner spårlöst. Penhale blir upprörd när hans efterträdare, Mark Mylow, anländer och försöker ta över.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 905
programme.desc: Någon har blivit skjuten. Penhale startar en utredning för att hitta förövaren.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 906
programme.desc: Martin och Louisa går på deras första barnlöshetsutredning, medan Penhale reagerar på ett vandaliseringsfall och får en fri surflektion.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 907
programme.desc: Mrs Tishell avskedar sin praktikant och Martin måste rusa upp med Buddy till Angela. AI flyttar officiellt in med Morwenna, vilket Caitlin tycker är roligare än vad Bert gör.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 908
programme.desc: Martin rusar hem till Ruth för ett sjukvårdsfall - men inser snabbt att det är han själv som är problemet.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Good-Bye
programme.desc: With Raintree in dire financial straits, Jean and Matt's willingness to consider a buyer's offer draws criticism from Pablo and Kris.

programme.title: Wildfire: Heartless
programme.desc: Kris increasingly becomes the object of Matt's affection; this renders his relationship with Gillian incompatible.

programme.title: Wildfire: Diplomacy
programme.desc: Kris and Matt's rekindled relationship comes as a shock to Junior, who is distracted by consoling Dani in her time of mourning.

programme.title: Wildfire: You Can't Count On Me
programme.desc: Kris' endeavors to get accustomed to her new relationship with Matt and deal with Pablo's departure are interrupted by a surprise visit from her half brother (Ignacio Serricchio).

programme.title: Wildfire: Picking Sides
programme.desc: Kris tries to repair the rift between Matt and Junior, but the tension is exacerbated by the approach of the important Bristol Stakes and the return of Gillian, who proceeds to resume her bonding with Junior.

programme.title: Scorpion: Mother Load
programme.desc: Paiges mamma anlitar Team Scorpion när hon av misstag upptäcker en bortglömd kärnreaktor som är på väg att explodera.

programme.title: Scorpion: This Is the Pits
programme.desc: Walter måste simma genom de livsfarliga La Brea-tjärgroparna när Team Scorpion hjälper en kvinna som fastnat i tjäran innan hon får slut på syre.

programme.title: Scorpion: Wreck the Halls
programme.desc: Det är julafton och Team Scorpions elektronikfria semester i bergen blir livsfarlig när de stöter på vapensmugglare och Ralph kidnappas när de försöker fly.

programme.title: Scorpion: Ice Ca-Cabes
programme.desc: När ett uppdrag i öknen resulterar i exploderande splitter som skadar Cabe allvarligt måste Team Scorpion frysa hans kropp för att rädda hans liv.

programme.title: Scorpion: Faux Money Maux Problems
programme.desc: När Team Scorpion luras att tillverka falska pengar för en utländsk enhet som vill förstöra den amerikanska ekonomin måste Paige förlita sig på sin mamma Veronicas färdigheter som bedragare för att rädda dem.

programme.title: Scorpion: The Hole Truth
programme.desc: Team Scorpion måste rädda en man som står på gränsen till ett enormt slukhål som hotar att förstöra Los Angeles vattenförsörjning för alltid.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV
programme.desc: When eight people, including two police officers, are executed in a coffee shop, an LAPD detective gets the team on the case, and they uncover a trail of blackmail, romance and corruption. Also, McGowan's investigation of Charlie and Don deepens.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV
programme.desc: When a passenger train collides with a freight train carrying toxic chemicals, Don, Charlie and the team begin to investigate if foul play was involved.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV
programme.desc: Don and his team are called in to help a veteran FBI agent track down a con man who has eluded him for years. Also, Agent McGowan hands down his decision on Charlie's security clearance and Don's future with the FBI.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV
programme.desc: The team hunts a crew stealing high-end goods from a shipping service and looks to an employee with savant-like abilities to lead them to those behind the scheme. Also, when one of Don's men is killed on duty, he questions his faith in the FBI.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV
programme.desc: While on a date, David catches a disappearing act at a magic show but quickly becomes involved in the performance when the magician really vanishes.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Patrons Ain't
programme.desc: När paret Heffernan inser att de borde ge mer till välgörenhet, handlar det som börjar som en fin gest snart bara om att få ära.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Bun Dummy
programme.desc: As his high school reunion approaches, Doug worries that Carrie's new hairdo will make her look like a librarian, rather than his usually sexy wife.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Shrink Wrap
programme.desc: Den fjärde säsongen avslutas med att Arthur besöker en psykiatriker. Han får en flashback till ett otrevligt möte med sin pappa som kan förklara hans stötande personlighet.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Eddie Money
programme.desc: Doug tar mot Carries order 100 dollar från "nödfondsburken" för att satsa på en boxningsmatch. När han och Deacon vinner 5 000, inser Doug att han inte kan berätta för Carrie att han vann stort utan att hon ska inse att han stal pengarna.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Two Thirty
programme.desc: Doug tror att hans nya tandläkare, som tidigare var kär i Carrie, skadar honom med flit.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Window Pain
programme.desc: Carrie känner sig underlägsen de nya grannarna och försöker göra ett gott intryck, men Doug är helt oberörd. Samtidigt försöker Arthur använda Spence för att få åka gratis på tunnelbanan.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Arthur, Spooner
programme.desc: När Carrie tillfälligt arbetar ett kvällsskift söker Doug sällskap från Arthur, och börjar vänja sig vid det.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Kirbed Enthusiasm
programme.desc: Deacon ber Doug att hjälpa honom träna Kirbys footballag och pojken utmanar Doug att provspela för ett halvproffslag, men Carrie gillar inte tanken - förrän hon får se ett intressant foto av honom.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Holy Mackerel
programme.desc: Doug och Carrie stöter på sin pastor och känner sig tvingade att gå i kyrkan. Under tiden överväger Arthur ett erbjudande om att köpa huset, trots att det inte är hans att sälja.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Jung Frankenstein
programme.desc: Carrie anser att Doug behöver hjälp med att kontrollera sina överdrivna matvanor så hon övertalar honom att gå till en terapeut. När Carrie får se vilka framsteg Doug gjort, ber hon terapeuten att arbeta på Dougs andra problem.

programme.title: Skål: The Executive's Executioner

programme.title: Skål: Cheerio Cheers

programme.title: Skål: The Bartender's Tale
programme.desc: Carla anställer en engelsk kvinna för att fylla Dianes plats medan hon är i Europa.

programme.title: Skål: The Belles of St. Clete's

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew

programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the drug trade in New York City was a nightmare. Dealers made millions. Street violence was out of control. The NYPD battled the drug gangs only to become their target.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Etna, New Hampshire is a small town. It's the kind of place where people trust their neighbors and leave their doors unlocked. A double murder shattered that trust and left the entire community terrified.

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding

programme.title: Meet the Spartans

programme.title: Joe Somebody

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2910

programme.title: Tattoo Fixers: Episode 1

programme.title: Tattoo Fixers: Episode 3

programme.title: Tattoo Fixers: Episode 4

programme.desc: Three weeks into the season Carlile Transportation has only delivered 500 of its 2,000 loads, the clock is ticking and an arctic storm is brewing; Hugh and Alex are joined by safety instructors on their first trip to Prudhoe Bay.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: A massive storm brings ice road traffic to a standstill; George Spears, Tim Freeman and Lisa Kelly take shelter at Coldfoot, the only truck stop on the road; Jack Jesse tries to outrun the storm.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: The crew breaking down the Langely site races to the finish line as rising temperatures melt the ice road; Hugh's back-heavy load makes it difficult to get traction on the slippery surface; rookie Devon Neff makes his debut run.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Warming temperatures cause cracks and flooding in the ice road, making the truckers' work a lot more dangerous; Jody and Brett take on the challenge of moving a 66-ton derrick; Hugh runs full steam ahead.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Hugh and Eric are neck and neck in their race to claim dominance over the ice road, but time is running out with the ocean waters closing in; the truckers race to remove equipment from the Langley site; an Arctic whiteout threatens operations.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

programme.desc: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.desc: 1953 Chevy-inspired bumper car; scores of M16 30-round magazines; reproduction 1940s boardwalk photobooth; aerosol-powered spud gun potato launchers.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 5
programme.desc: Battling to keep the flow of patients moving is Sister Jane Hawksworth but she’s got a problem. They’re two porters down and it’s causing a backlog, but the emergencies keep arriving.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 6
programme.desc: We spend an eventful night shift with Barnsley Hospital’s Casualty team. Evenings are a peak time for road traffic collisions and the most critical cases are blue lit straight to Casualty.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 7
programme.desc: Registrar Doctor Ashleigh Trimble takes the next call from paramedics. 81-year-old Roy is being blue lighted in, after falling over and landing badly on one of his artificial hips.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 8
programme.desc: With an already busy department, Nurse Chloe Wesley answers the red emergency phone. A 23-month-old toddler is being rushed in with suspected sepsis, a life-threatening condition that attacks the internal organs.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 9
programme.desc: Registrar Doctor Rob Cornford heads straight to Resus to treat 58-year-old window-fitter Craig who’s been blue-lighted in. He was working on a ladder on the first floor of a house when he fell and was knocked unconscious.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 10
programme.desc: Sister Jane Hawksworth has clocked on for a night shift to find every bed in Barnsley Hospital is taken. To get the department moving again Sister Jane and the close-knit Casualty team will have to pull together.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 4

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 5
programme.desc: In the London suburb of Enfield, former workaholic Sandra has become a hoard-aholic since retiring. Her compulsion to spend is out of control, and everything is added to the growing mountains of books, clothes and candles…

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 3
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of married couple Lynne and Keith from Chudleigh in South Devon whose house hasn’t had a deep clean since they moved in nearly 20 years ago.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 4
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Anita from Manchester, who’s house is overrun with her 3 cats who make a mess wherever they like.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 5
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Scout Leader and Single mum of two; Debbie from South London, whose 2-bed flat is drowning in clutter and filth.

programme.title: Hoarders: Episode 6
programme.desc: In South Wales, 49-year-old Alison has always been a hoarder. What started as a passion for teddy bears has transformed into an obsession for. She currently has 11 and they rule the house, at least the bits they can get to in between the hoard…

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 15

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 16
programme.desc: There's a tricky situation for Recovery Operator Stephen in Warwickshire after an overnight frost makes a narrow country lane as slippery as an ice rink, causing a road sweeper to slide into a ditch.

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 17

programme.title: Trucking Hell: Episode 18

programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 8: Extravehicular Activity
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Danger, Asteroids Ahead
programme.desc: The threat of an asteroid strike is a very real danger in our solar system, mankind is now in a position to defend the planet from such an eventuality.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication
programme.desc: Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Klovn: En Revisor-smurf-cd

programme.title: Klovn: God Jul, Frank

programme.title: Klovn: Unga Hjärtan

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrible Henchman

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16

programme.title: The Love Boat: The Captain's Crush/ Out Of My Hair/ Off-Course Romance
programme.desc: When Stubing meets a gorgeous movie queen (Joan Collins), who recently shed her ninth husband, he is fascinated by her charm and beauty. Then, a man decides to prioritize golf over his wife, so the neglected woman decides to play ball with an old friend.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Discount Romance/ Vicky'S Dilemma/ Loser, And Still Champ
programme.desc: The captain's daughter is put in a tough situation she is accused of stealing supplements from Doc's office. Then, Gopher's uncle (Red Button) falls in love with the lady who runs the ship's gift shop.

programme.title: The Love Boat: So Help Me Hannah/ The Maid Cleans Up/ Cpr, I.O.U
programme.desc: The vivacious Hannah Harvye (Mary Martin) immediately becomes involved with the crew and rekindles a romance with an old flame. An unassuming man (Ben Murphy) finds himself in a tight situation with a maid he's never met. Gopher saves a man's life.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Love Boat - The World's Greatest Kisser/ Don'T Take My Wife, Please/ The Reluctant Father
programme.desc: A jilted fiance hires a Mata Hari (Elaine Joyce) to find the crew member that ruined his wedding plans; a junior executive (Parker Stevenson) suffers in silence while his boss (David Doyle) lusts after his bride.

programme.title: Wings: A Black Eye Affair
programme.desc: As Helen prepares for the annual Cranberry Festival, picking berries in the woods and baking cranberry muffins, she receives a last-minute call from Davis. After canceling numerous times, he is flying in to spend the evening with her.

programme.title: Wings: Joe Blows (Part 1)
programme.desc: In part one of a two-part story line ala "Sunset Boulevard," Joe runs away from home when the pressures of his life finally push him to the edge, leaving the responsibilities of the business and everyone's happiness in his dust.

programme.title: Wings: Joe Blows (Part 2)
programme.desc: In part two, Joe has been missing for three days after running away from home to escape the pressures of his life. While everyone is concerned and blaming each other, Brian is frantically trying to run the airline and deal with overdue bills.

programme.title: Wings: 2 Good 2 B 4 Gotten
programme.desc: When Joe finds out that an old friend, Sandy Cooper (guest star Valerie Mahaffey), is in town visiting, he swears that she was obsessed with him in high school.

programme.title: Wings: Come Fly With Me

programme.title: Wings: Ready, Teddy, Go
programme.desc: Davis finally shows up to visit Helen and wants to take the whole gang out to lunch to get to know each other better. While he freshens up at the hotel, they start raiding the mini-bar and nosing around in his suitcase.

programme.title: Wings: Happy Holidays

programme.title: Wings: Oh, Give Me A Home Where The Mather's Don't Roam

programme.title: Wings: The Faygitive

programme.title: Wings: Say Uncle, Carlton

programme.title: Happy Days: Richie Gets Framed

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonzie'S Funeral (Part 1)

programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: iCarly: iNTE uthärdligt

programme.title: iCarly: Jag älskar dej

programme.title: iCarly: iTån och Fat Cakes

programme.title: iCarly: iSynproblem

programme.title: iCarly: iTabbar 2: Electric Tabbaloo

programme.title: iCarly: iFortfarande galen

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna väljer singellivet för att komma närmare sina medarbetare. Tamara arrangerar en tjusig, men inte så mysig, födelsedagsfest för Sadie.

programme.desc: Jenna försöker välja mellan framgången på Idea Bin och vänskapen med Matty. Sadie och Sergio finner sig själva avslöja mer än någonsin förut.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna måste välja mellan ett viktigt evenemang på SCU och en återföreningsfest, vilket leder till ett ännu viktigare val: Luke eller Matty. Men hon är inte ensam om att stå inför svåra val, Jake, Tamara, och Lissa är alla i samma situation.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 104

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Reunion Begins
programme.desc: Charlotte, Holly, Sophie och Marnies plan för en 10-årsfest för Geordiegänget börjar ta form. Tidigare och nuvarande medlemmar kommer till 'The Toon', men är det alla som röjer?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Geordies Invade Portugal!
programme.desc: Återförening & Chloes och Bethans osämja kulminerar, är deras vänskap över för gott...? Originaldeltagarna landar i Portugal för en rolig familjesemester! Men vem mer och vad från det förflutna hoppar på nästa plan till Algarve?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Reunion Continues
programme.desc: Återträffen fortsätter, med nya överraskningar. Vissa ses igen för första gången på flera år. Vissa kan försonas och gå vidare, andra kommer aldrig mer att tala med varandra. Allt kan hända när den sista överraskningen dyker upp.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Trouble On The Horizon!
programme.desc: Chloe Ferrys chockartade ankomst orsakar en ringar-på-vattnet-effekt i gruppen! Nathan försöker lugna ner läget genom att ta med tjejerna på en andlig retreat. En geordie till flyger till Portugal... Men alla blir inte glada över det!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Holly's Hen Do
programme.desc: När Louis kommer blir det dramatik. Charlotte och Sophie överraskar Holly med en möhippa på en båt. De får ett oväntat besök i villan som chockar hela Algarve

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Answer to the Big Question
programme.desc: Resan till Algarve närmar sig sitt slut. Louis handlingar fortsätta skapa bråk i gänget, och Holly får äntligen svar på frågan som alla har ställt sig.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Bonusklipp

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Once More Unto the Beach
programme.desc: Alla återvänder till Seaside en sista gång. The Situation avslöjar allt om sitt missbruk och Snooki ställs inför utmaningen att vara gravid i ett partyhus.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: No Shame, Good Integrity
programme.desc: Rumskompisarna återgår till sina strandhusvanor och Deena kämpar med att vara ifrån sin pojkvän. Nicole fattar ett beslut som chockar hela huset.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Toxic Shots Syndrome
programme.desc: Snooki flyttar ut ur huset för att bo på egen hand, och Deena har det svårt utan sin köttbulle. Mike får tampas med nykterhetens avigsidor efter ett besök hos doktorn.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: When investigators found Bruce Miller dead in the office of his junkyard business, the crime scene was almost pristine. But when a computer forensics expert examined computers owned by the victim's wife and her lover, he found all the evidence needed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: The Spying Game: War in the Shadows
programme.desc: The KGB exploits betrayal in US counterintelligence.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: Combat Forces: Snipers
programme.desc: Silent, covert, deadly; they're a commander’s secret weapon. Snipers are the long-range killers on the battlefield. We travel to several renowned sniper schools to see them train and learn about their advanced technology weapons and unique field craft.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues: Sandstorm
programme.desc: Dust storms frequently paralyze public life during the storm season in many of the most arid regions of the Earth, burying roads and human settlements.

programme.title: Trekking the Great Wall
programme.desc: Though one of the oldest and largest man-made structures in the world, the Great Wall of China is also one of the least known. Exploring it has become the lifetime obsession of British historian William Lindesay, who has lived in China for 20 years.

programme.title: On the Case: Tangled Web
programme.desc: A romantic Valentine's Day rendezvous ends in murder.

programme.title: On the Case: A Knock on the Door
programme.desc: A beautiful young mother is found murdered in the bedroom of her home. The only witness was her five year old son. Would he be able to help police solve the crime?

programme.title: On the Case: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: A young mother is murdered in broad daylight with her toddler just a few feet away. Police have little to go on except the bizarre description eyewitnesses have given them of the brazen killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: In order to solve the vicious double murder of a beloved couple, police must uncover a cold blooded killer's carefully calculated plot.

programme.title: On the Case: A Tangled Past
programme.desc: When a daughter investigates her sick mother's death, she begins to wonder if the cause of her untimely end was really murder.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Expect the Unexpected
programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine. High winds wreak havoc for Devan and his crew on another C-46 mission to help clean up an oil spill in the Northwest Territories.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Coming Home
programme.desc: Rookie waterbomber pilot Scott gets his first taste of action when Buffalo responds to an emergency callout to fight fires in Alberta. Mikey and Rod think they hit the jackpot when they buy a million dollar firefighting plane on eBay at a bargain price.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shut Down
programme.desc: Joe receives a negative visit from Transport Canada when inspectors threaten to shut down the airline. Ray and the Electra crew fly to Sachs Harbour to pick up a unique load - the hides, wool, and meat of 250 musk oxen.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Tale of Two Pilots
programme.desc: Weighed down by the responsibility of training a new rampie, and struggling to get out of Joe's doghouse, DC-3 co-pilot Tyler gets a once in a lifetime opportunity to stunt fly in his Cessna 150 for a visiting film crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Jam
programme.desc: After taking command of an intense airlift, and dealing with the ugliest Electra load he's ever seen, Scott takes a scary fall on the icy tarmac.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna måste välja mellan ett viktigt evenemang på SCU och en återföreningsfest, vilket leder till ett ännu viktigare val: Luke eller Matty. Men hon är inte ensam om att stå inför svåra val, Jake, Tamara, och Lissa är alla i samma situation.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det blir bara värre för Jenna Hamilton när ett mystiskt brev får alla att felaktigt tro att hon försökt begå självmord. I stället för att låta den nya stämpeln fastna förändrar Jenna sitt liv.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie och Lissa sexmessar nakenbilder av Jenna i tjejernas omklädningsrum till hela skolan. Trots allt åtlöje och skvaller kommer det en oväntad reaktion från Jennas förälskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrar om Matty tänker göra deras förhållande allmänt känt när han bjuder henne på en fest. Jenna inser samtidigt att hon kanske har mer gemensamt med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vill definiera förhållandet med Matty, men hon oroar sig för att hon kan förlora honom på kuppen. Tamara gottar sig i sin första sexskandal när hon får bindhinneinflammation efter jacuzzihångel.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: Jennas självmordsstigma kommer på tapeten igen när en underlig stalker gör sig känd. Jenna börjar undra om hennes rykte gör att Matty inte kan se henne som flickvän.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna minglar med de elaka tjejerna när hon gör ett försök att platsa i Palos Verdes främsta välgörenhetsorganisation för mödrar och döttrar. Och det blir bara värre när hon stöter på Matty och Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i skolans uppsättning om rattfylleri. Medan hon kämpar med rollen kämpar Jake och Matty med att fånga hennes uppmärksamhet.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: När Laceys bästis Ally kommer på besök bestämmer de sig för att 'hjälpa' Jenna att hålla världens fest. Nästa dag försöker en glömsk och bakfull Jenna att rekonstruera kvällens händelser för att lista ut vem hon kysste.

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jennas sextonårsdag är pinsam nog, men hon måste även ta tag i festens efterdyningar. När hon blir kuggad på uppkörningen undrar hon om hon nånsin kan få förhållandena med Matty och Tamara på rätt köl igen.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty bjuder ut Jenna på en riktig första dejt. Men det dröjer inte länge innan hon börjar ifrågasätta förhållandet med Matty igen.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Ryan Stout
programme.desc: Ryan Stout beskriver sitt favoritskratt, förklarar fördelarna med att vara hemlös och talar om varför han inte behöver svordomar i sin show - eller i porr.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV
programme.desc: When a super computer is the prime suspect in the death of cutting-edge scientist, the team must use new means to crack the case. Meanwhile, Charlie weighs a compelling job offer.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV
programme.desc: The team has only hours to investigate a last minute tip that could exonerate a dangerous mob boss on the eve of his execution. Meanwhile, Charlie attempts to help the CalSci basketball team break their incredible losing streak.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV
programme.desc: The investigation into a professor's death takes a dangerous turn when the team finds their lead suspect has ties to a radical animal rights group.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV
programme.desc: When the FBI is called in to investigate a series of home invasions, the team uses Charlie and his math skills to help profile the suspects, but when his calculations go awry during a raid, Don suffers a life-threatening injury.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV
programme.desc: Still feeling responsible for Don's near-fatal stabbing, Charlie puts his focus into tracking down an unnoticed serial killer, with the agents revisiting math theories from when Charlie first started working with the team to help solve the case.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Taste Buds
programme.desc: Eftersom Doug aldrig får som han vill när han ber Carrie, låter han Arthur be åt honom. Samtidigt står Spence först i kön till att få se en ny film.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Dog Shelter
programme.desc: Janet berättar för Carrie att Doug hade en hund när han var elva, som de påstår ännu är vid liv. Men Janet erkänner sen för Carrie att hunden dog och att de ersatt den - flera gånger - utan att Doug märkt något.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Pilot
programme.desc: I premiäravsnittet rubbas Dougs tillvaro när hans svärfar, den nylige blivne änkemannen Arthur (Stiller), flyttar in hos dem istället för på ett ålderdomshem och gör Dougs tv-rum till Arthurs sovrum.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Fat City
programme.desc: Medan Arthur bläddrar igenom en gammal fotobok visar han Doug en bild på Carries mor, som blir förbluffad över hur överviktig hon blev med åldern.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Cello, Goodbye
programme.desc: Carries måste ofta jobba över på den tjusiga advokatfirman på Manhattan och när hennes stilige chef ger henne skjuts hem i sin fräcka sportbil, blir Doug lite orolig.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Richie's Song
programme.desc: Doug förstår inte varför Carrie vägrar gå på dubbeldejt med Richie och hans fru Marie.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Paternal Affairs
programme.desc: Dougs faster Sheila (gästspelas av Brenda Vaccaro) kommer på besök efter att ha separerat från sin make. Doug förfäras när Arthur blir betagen av Sheila och ber om tillåtelse att uppvakta henne.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Head First
programme.desc: Carrie har dåligt samvete för att Arthur inte har några vänner och uppmuntrar Doug att hitta på saker med honom. Doug går motvilligt med på att låta Arthur följa med och upptäcker att Carrie är tacksam för Dougs generositet. Väldigt tacksam.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: The Rock
programme.desc: När Carrie lämnar in sin förlovningsring på rengöring hos en juvelerare, får hon veta att det är en sällsynt och mycket värdefull ring.

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Educating Doug

programme.title: Kungen av Queens: Road Rayge
